stars.name: Achernar

stars.name: Alcyone
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mars and the Moon. It causes love, eminence, blindness from fevers, small-pox, and accidents to the face. For further particulars sec Pleiades.
stars.notes: A greenish yellow star and brightest of the Pleiades, situated on the shoulder of the Bull. From early times it has been thought to be the central Sun round which the universe revolves, and was A1 Wasat, the Central One, of the Arabs, and Tcmennu, the Foundation Stone, of the Babylonians, but this idea has now been abandoned by astronomers. Alcyone marked the beginning of the 4th ecliptic constellation of the Babylonians, and as Amba. the Mother, formed the junction star between the Hindu nakshatras Krittika and Roliini. It is frequently called the Hen.

Sober, industrious, popular, in- clined to be religious, somewhat extravagant but well-off, help through friends, holds position of trust in large company or corporation, or receives promo- tion under direction, favourable for health and domestic affairs.
stars.culminating: High office under Government, great profit and reputation. If at the same time with Sun, Moon or Jupiter, ample fortune and great honour.

aspects.jupiter: Benefits from legal and Church matters, influential position, danger of hypocrisy, gain through foreign affairs or shipping.
aspects.neptune: Ingenious, business instincts, changeable, and loss through this means, mediuin- istic and rather negative, associated Hath societies as an official, loss and misfortune in middle age which hastens death, favourable for friendship, partnership. marriage and success, greatly dependent upon advice of marriage partner.
aspects.saturn: Honest, selfish, inclined to be mean, shrewd in business, materialistic, favourable for gain and speculation and for domestic matters, but early difficulty in married life, favour- able for children but disagreement with one of them.
aspects.uranus: Favourable for work entailing quick buying and selling and for dealing with the public, associated with antiques or ancient matters and given to forming collections, associated with art. science or literature, official position in some club or society, favourable for gain, benefits from friends, favourable for marriage and children and benefit through both, natural death abroad.
aspects.venus: Popular, gifts and favours from friends, some false friends of own sex. With Mats. Popular, many friends, considerable gain but does not save owing to extravagance. If in 1st, 7th, gth, 10th or nth houses and the Moon is at the same time with Pollux, danger of death by suffocation.

stars.name: Armus

stars.notes: Situated in the heart of the Goat.

stars.name: Ascella
stars.influence: Of the nature of Jupiter and Mer- cury. It gives good fortune and happiness.
stars.notes: A binary star situated in the armpit of Sagittarius.
stars.with_sun: Good fortune and lasting happiness.
stars.with_moon: New and influential friends, valu- able gifts, love of respectable women. 29. Aselli. 7 and S Cancri. SI 6° 25' and 7 ° 36'.

Favour- able for gain, unrelenting nature, domestic dishar- mony caused by antipathy between one of the children and the native or partner.
aspects.mars: Courageous, generous, noble, just, power and authority.
aspects.mercury: Power and authority after many difficulties, little gain, numerous expenses, losses by writings, mortgages and bonds. 143
aspects.neptune: Proud, haughty, great self-esteem, occult interests, prominent and influential position in a company concerned with stocks and shares or speculation, connected with schools or places of amusement, early difficulties with parents, favourable for gain but danger of loss by fire or theft, favourable for marriage but sometimes one of convenience.
aspects.saturn: Untrustworthy, dishonourable, low morality, bad habits formed early in life.
aspects.uranus: Energetic, reformer, blunt in speech and often bitter, fixed ideas, honest, careless or broad in religion, many friends among the public, some of whom abuse confidence, enemies among the higher classes, governmental position, involved in disputes with corporations owing to socialistic in- terests, favourable for gain and domestic matters, likelihood of unexpected death abroad.
aspects.venus: Proud, opinionated, help from an influential friend, favourable for gain.

stars.name: Baten Kaitos
stars.influence: Of the nature of Satum. It gives compulsory transportation, change or emigration, misfortune by force or accident, shipwreck but also rescue, falls and blows.
stars.notes: A topaz-yellow star in the body of the Whale. From A 1 Batn al Kaitos, the Whale's Belly.

stars.with_sun: Vacillating, changeable, indecisive in business, mechanical ability, riches and honour but final ruin, blindness by accident, disease, extreme sickness, fevers or violent death.
stars.with_moon: Luxury, lust, vain ambition,’ waste, ruin, blindness by accidents, great power, honour and wealth, honour in martial matters, as soldier, sur- geon, metal worker ; may attain distinction through courage. . K

aspects.jupiter: Philosophical and religious mind, hypocrisy, maybe fanatic.legal prominence, andgreat honour but danger of slander.
aspects.mars: Strength, energy, success as soldier, surgeon or metal worker, liable to accidents.
aspects.mercury: Honour and preferment in mili- tary matters, favourable for friendship and social affairs.
aspects.neptune: Keen intellect, extremist, little forethought or balance, many quarrels, ability for mercantile pursuits, associated with companies connected with patents or electrical instruments, bad for marriage or partnership, many unexpected events, fairly good for gain, many narrow escapes but eventual violent death.
aspects.saturn: Secluded and studious life, re- served, thoughtful, unfavourable for gain owing to lack of interest, poverty at end of life, often single but if married the partner may die young, no children.
aspects.uranus: Mental disturbance, much activity, occult or unpractical interests, repeatedly suffers through the same mistakes, disharmony with re- latives and neighbours, successful in the occupation of making peculiar machinery but little financial gain ; unfavourable for domestic matters, many minor accidents.
aspects.venus: Much suffering through love affairs owing to unrestrained feelings.

stars.name: Betelgeuze
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Mars and Mercury ; and, to Alvidas, of Mercury, Saturn and Jupiter in good aspect. It gives martial honour, preferment and wealth. 1 f culminating. Great military fortune, command, invention, ingenuity and helps in the perfection of arts and sciences. If at the same time with Sun, Moon or Jupiter, ample fortune and great honour.

stars.with_sun: Interest in and ability for occult and mystical subjects; acute diseases, feyers, honour and preferment ending in final ruin.
stars.with_moon: Active mind, strong will, turbulent, rebellious under restraint, military success but suffering through quarrels with superiors, likelihood of great power, honour and wealth.

aspects.jupiter: Serious and studious mind, shrewd and profitable business dealings, great honour in the Church or law.
aspects.mars: Cautious, reserved, good leader and organizer, honour and preferment in martial matters.
aspects.mercury: Serious, studious, scientific and literary ; unfavourable for gain, fame through writings or engravings m metal, favourable for health but liable to accidents.
aspects.neptune: Ingenious, mechanical ability, may invent mechanical device, spiritualistic interests, some physical ailment or affliction or mental de- rangement, not good for gain but greatest success in partnership, favourable for marriage and children but disharmony with brothers and sisters, liable to some serious or fatal accident in middle age.
aspects.saturn: Shrewd, cunning, craftily dishonest, treacherous to friends, eventful life with many ups and downs, eventual wealth but little comfort, unfavourable for domestic matters. '
aspects.uranus: Quick, active and evil mind,"" clever criminal, notorious as forger or counterfeiter but rarely caught, quiet pleasant manner, generous and not bad at heart, possesses hypnotic and thought- reading powers.
aspects.venus: Somewhat retiring and reserved, great ability as a maker of fine ornaments, favourable for gain, some sorrow connected with the family or marriage.

stars.name: Bos

stars.notes: A small star situated in the Goat’s face.

stars.name: Bungula

stars.with_moon: Success in martial matters as a soldier, surgeon, metal worker, etc.
stars.culminating: Great glory, fame and wealth, dignity and authority by the help of an old clergy- man or influential person.

aspects.jupiter: Great ecclesiastical or legal honour and preferment, ritualistic tendencies, success in foreign countries, favourable for gain.
aspects.mars: Physical endurance, considerable mental power, speaker or writer, little prominence.
aspects.mercury: Changeable, vacillating, fault- finding, difficult to please, good intellect, business success, trouble in domestic affairs through enemies, family sickness, disappointed ambitions.
aspects.neptune: Occult interests, psychic or mediumistic, deceitful, dishonest, many journeys and voyages often to the cast of birthplace, rarely long in one place, occupation of a watery nature or connected with places of amusement and small speculations, favourable for gain and domestic ' matters, heavy business losses at end of life, death caused by Scorpio ailment. aspects.uranus: Selfish, self-seeking, jealous of others’ success, dishonest, determined but indecisive in some things, loss through law, enemies and mercurial affairs, little prominence at home and greater reputation abroad, loss of friends, death through virulent disease.
aspects.venus: Popular, artistic and musical abilities, benefits from friends, danger from love affairs.

stars.name: Capella

It gives honour, wealth, eminence, renown, a public position of trust and eminent friends, and makes its natives careful, timorous, inquisitive, very fond of knowledge and particularly of novelties. 1 J culminating. Military, naval or ecclesiastical connections and preferment, waste, dissipation, envy. and trouble. If at the same time with Sun, Moon or Jupiter, ample fortune and great honour.
stars.notes: A white star situated on the body of the Goat in the arms of Auriga. The name means Little She-Goat. Sometimes called Amalthea in honour of the nurse who reared Jupiter upon the milk of the goat.
stars.with_sun: Vacillating, changeable, too loqua- cious, quick speech, misunderstood and criticised, martial honour and wealth. '
stars.with_moon: Inquisitive, loquacious, indiscreet speech, sarcastic, quarrelsome, many journeys and voyages, domestic disharmony, danger to sight, liable to accidents.

aspects.jupiter: Legal or ecclesiastical connections, slander and criticism, too enthusiastic or zealous, many voyages, trouble with relatives.
aspects.mars: Intellectual, learned, talents wasted on low subjects.
aspects.mercury: Disagreeable experiences, legal action over writings and success after much difficulty.
aspects.neptune: Prominent psychological writer, high ambitions and moderate success, courageous, rash, studious, connected with inventions to do with methods of transit, many journeys, peculiar hygienic ideas, disharmony with brothers, unfavourable for children, accidents in early life, health collapses in middle age necessitating confinement but mental faculties remain active. - 37. aspects.uranus: Eccentric, mentally unbalanced or insane, clever inventor especially in connection with electricity, dependent upon others, little gain, pe- culiar religious views, unfavourable for domestic affairs; children, if any, weak in intellect.
aspects.venus: Literary and poetical ability, un- favourable for gain.

stars.name: Capulus
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mars and Mercury. It causes blindness or defective eyesight.
stars.notes: A double cluster situated in the sword hand of Perseus.

stars.name: Castor
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Mercury; to Wilson, Simmonite and Pearce, of Mars, Venus and Saturn ; and, to Alvidas, of the Moon, Mars and Uranus. It gives distinction, a keen intellect, success in law and .publishing. many travels, fondness for horses, sudden fame and honour but often followed by loss of fortune , and disgrace, sickness, trouble and great affliction. Its natives are said to be mischievous and prone to violence.
stars.notes: A binary star, bright white and pale white, situated on the head of the Northern Twin. It represents Castor, the mortal one of the twins, famous for his skill in taming and managing horses Sometimes called Apollo, and symbolically named A Ruler yet to Come.
stars.with_sun: Prominence in occult matters, government work dealing with foreign affairs, serious accidents, blows, stabs, shooting, shipwreck, injuries to the face, blindness, disease, violent fevers, evil disposition, rape or murder committed or suffered, imprisonment, banishment, decapitation.
stars.with_moon: Timid, sensitive, lacks confidence, occult interest and psychic ability, blindness, in- juries to face, disgrace, stabs, wounds, imprisonment.
stars.culminating: Blindness, bad eyes, injuries to the face, disgrace, stabs, wounds, imprisonment.

aspects.jupiter: Philosophical and occult interests, loss through law, speculation or travel, danger of judicial sentence.
aspects.mars: Evil disposition, much travel, aim- less life, many ups and downs.
aspects.mercury: Remarkable psychic powers entailing criticism and ridicule but eventual pro- minence, unfavourable for gam.

aspects.uranus: Conscientious, sensitive, impres- sionable, great psychic power entailing much public criticism, desirous of pleasing all, favourable for marriage and gain, few, if any, children but har- monious relations with them, loss in early life of the parent of opposite sex to native.
aspects.venus: Strange and peculiar life, many extreme ups and downs, unfavourable for marriage.

If the moon is with Saturn also, drown- ing and assassination. With a malefic and the Moon at the same time with Markab, death at human hands.
stars.culminating: Legacies, love or dissipation, gravity and austerity. 157

stars.name: Copula

stars.name: Dabih

stars.with_sun: Reserved, suspicious and mistrustful, loss through friends, responsible public position of trust and authority.
stars.with_moon: Successful in business but retires under a cloud, favourable for wealth, influential position but scarcely realizes ambitions, trouble through opposite sex, deserved criticism and censure.

aspects.jupiter: Hypocrisy, dishonesty, high legal or ecclesiastical preferment but ultimate disgrace.
aspects.mars: Great ambition, energy, high posi- tion but danger of reversal, domestic disharmony.
aspects.mercury: Reserved,, suspicious, envious, - self-centred, prominent position in public affairs or companies, favourable for gain, bad for domestic affairs, peculiar home conditions. With Vtnus. Secret Jove affairs, sorrow and disappointment, easily led astray, enmity of women.

aspects.mars: Danger from enemies, accidents, honour and preferment but many quarrels and final disgrace, violent death.

aspects.uranus: Many sorrows, engaged in reform, unbalanced mind, may seek someone's life as a mission, unfavourable for gain and marriage, strange and peculiar or violent death.

It gives swift judgment, despair, regrets, public disgrace, misfortune from the elements of nature, and happiness turned to anger, and makes its natives noble, daring, self-controlled, generous and busy with other people's affairs.

aspects.mars: Bitter, vindictive, cruel, unpopular, loss of position and public disgrace.
aspects.mercury: Many losses through agents or servants and through writings, bad for gain, loss of one of the family through malignant or contagious disease.
aspects.neptune: Disagreeable, ingenious, clever, sarcastic, bitter in speech, domestic quarrels, accidents and sickness in early life, death in middle age by an accident or lingering illness.

stars.with_moon: Pioneer, reckless, headstrong, violent temper, many quarrels, bad for gain and business.

aspects.venus: Reserved, passionate, many secret love affairs.

stars.name: Diram
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mercury and Venus. It gives force, energy, power and protection.
stars.notes: A double star, crocus yellow and blue, in the left foot of the Northern Twin. From A1 Dirah, the Seed or Branch. Symbolically called the Abused or Beaten One.

stars.with_moon: Quarrels with questionable associ- ates, business success, environment detrimental owing to wife, partner or relative.

aspects.mars: Good lawyer, speaker, and debater, quick-witted.

stars.notes: The nebula in the Archer’s Face.

aspects.venus: Secret and passionate love affairs, some restriction in the life, disappointments, easily led astray.

stars.name: Graffjas
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the na- ture of Mars and Saturn ; and. to Alvidas, o! Jupiter in square to Saturn and the Moon. It causes ex- treme malevolence, mercilessness, fiendishness, re- pulsivcness, malice, theft, crime, pestilence, and con- tagious diseases.
stars.notes: A triple star, pale white and lilac, si- tuated on the head of the Scorpion, and frequently called Frons Scorpii.
stars.with_sun: Materialistic, too active a mind, ecclesiastical difficulties, bad health. Otherwise similar to the effect if rising.
stars.with_moon: Great power, honour, wealth, gilts, difficulty in obtaining legacy, materialistic, inter- ested in unpopular ideas, criticized, success after many difficulties. Otherwise similar to the effect if rising.
stars.culminating: Riches and preferment attended by danger, violence, trouble, sickness, benefits seldom last.

aspects.jupiter: Hypocritical, real or pretended religious zeal, legacies attended by legal diffi- culties.
aspects.mars: Athletic, suffers from over-exertion goes to extremes, active mind, favourable for money matters but extravagant and has many debts.
aspects.mercury: Dull mind, difficulty in expression or defect in speech, gifts, difficulty in obtaining legacy but final success.
aspects.neptune: Connected with science, inven- tions, ‘ companies, or Journalism, breeds horses or cattle, good mind, late but favourable marriage but peculiar domestic conditions, accidents in middle age, death after lingering illness.
aspects.saturn: Cautious, cunning, self-seeking, deceitful, dishonourable, progressive ideas, religious but hypocritical, proud of home, loss by fire or water, gain through marriage and partnership, few children, long life.
aspects.uranus: Scientific, religious or philosophical work, difficulties with marriage partner’s relatives, favourable for marriage and children, domestic difficulties finally overcome, trouble with parents in early life, favourable for gain and speculation, loss through Mercurial matters, liable to accidents by fire and electricity, sudden death.
aspects.venus: Dishonest, self-seeking, energetic, able, favourable for gain.

stars.name: Hamal
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the na- ture of Mars and Saturn ; and, to A 1 Vidas, of Venus and Saturn. It causes violence, brutishness, cruelty and premeditated crime. 171 With Stitt. -Dissipation, evil associates, loss and disgrace.
stars.notes: A yellow star situated in the forehead of the Ram and commonly known as the ram's FoI-_ lowing Horn. From A 1 Hamal, the Sheep. Sym- bolically called the Death Wound and often in- correctly named El Nath.
stars.with_moon: Patient, slow success through hard work, trouble through love affairs but favourable for marriage, marriage partner gains by business or speculation.

aspects.jupiter: Dissipated, hypocritical, legal or ecclesiastical preferment, loss by speculation.
aspects.mercury: Dull mind, many friends, great determination, tactful, greatly influenced by mar- riage partner.
aspects.neptune: Strong character, firm, occult interests, mental disturbance at end of life, con- nected with societies, success in business connected with clothing or ornaments, success in dealing with opposite sex, domestic harmony, accumulates u calth, sudden death.
aspects.saturn: Cautious, thoughtful, critical, sar- castic, materialistic, intcicstcd m geology or agri- culture, some domestic happiness, favourable for gain . '
aspects.uranus: Pleasant, sympathetic, easily influenced, sensitive, strong passions, weak nature, mediumistic, dnnk or detrimental habits, many friends, love troubles, death under distressing cir- cumstances.
aspects.venus: Handsome, quiet, envious, jealous, domestic trouble, ill-health to native or family. Wiffr Mars. Violence, criminal tendencies, in- fluential position but final disgrace and ruin.

stars.name: Has
stars.influence: Of the nature of Saturn and Venus. It brings trouble and disgrace.
stars.notes: A small star situated near the left knee of Ophiuckus.
stars.with_sun: Sickness, disgrace and ruin. '
stars.with_moon: Disgrace, ruin, and ailments affect- ing those parts ruled by Sagittarius. ,

stars.name: IsiDIS
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the na- ture of Mars and Saturn ; and, to AJ vidas, of Jupiter in square to the Moon. It causes sudden^ assaults, malevolence, immorality and shamelessness.
stars.notes: Situated near the right claw of the Scor- pion.
stars.with_sun: Immoral, dissipated, low associates, many sorrows.
stars.with_moon: Reserved, suspicious, bad for busb ness success, disgrace, loss by horses and cattle.

aspects.jupiter: Deceitful, dishonest, dissipated, low companions, danger of imprisonment. »
aspects.mars: Immoral, criminal, violent, evil en- vironment, sudden or violent death.
aspects.mercury: Hypocritical, evil mind, low associates, imprisonment, malignant disease but chances of recovery, criminal, secrets in connection with life or parentage, domestic disharmony.
aspects.neptune: Active mind, weak character, easily led, ruined through opposite sex, organizing ability, high position but subsequent disgrace, ac- cidents from fire, water and electricity, death by accident or by human hands.
aspects.saturn: Vacillating, strong passions, evil habits, low associates, may be disowned by family, several unhappy marriages, early death of favourite child, death from consumption.
aspects.uranus: Shrewd, cunning, excellent lin- guist, bad morals, trouble through opposite sex, bad 173 for marriage, many enemies, strange adventures abroad — sometimes as spy, bad for gain, obscure death.
aspects.venus: Quiet, reserved, jealous, selfish, favourable for gain.

stars.name: Khambalia
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mercury and Mars. It causes swift violence, unreliability, changeability, and an argumentative nature.
stars.notes: A small star situated on the left foot of Virgo . From the Coptic meaning Crooked-clawed.

stars.name: LESATH
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mercury and Mars. It gives danger, desperation, immorality and malevo- lence, and is connected with acid poisons.
stars.notes: A small star situated on the sting of the Scorpion. From A 1 Las'ah, the Sting.

stars.name: Labkum
stars.influence: Of the nature of Venus and Mercury. It gives ideality, psychic power, intelligence, honour and riches in disgrace and purifies to salvation.
stars.notes: Situated in the Cup, and symbolically called the Holy Grail.
stars.culminating: Ecclesiastical preferment, or very good fortune.

stars.name: Makkeb
stars.influence: Of the nature of Saturn and Jupiter, It gives piety, a wide knowledge, educational work and voyages.
stars.notes: A small star in the Buckler of the Ship.
stars.culminating: Profitable journeys in company with Jupiterian and Saturnian people wherein native is grave and discreet but suffers much injury which ultimately turns to good.

stars.name: Male
stars.with_sun: Great help from friends, gifts and legacies if not afflicted, military preferment after great struggles and expense.
stars.with_moon: Occult interests, restless, never remains long in one place, quarrels with friends, partners and employers. If at the same time the Sun and Mars be with Deneb Adige or Wcga, above the earth, death from the bite of a mad dog.
stars.culminating: Artful, crafty, dissembling, wealth by violence and rapine, lust, dissipation, waste and ruin, military preferment, quarrels, loss in trade or by servants.

aspects.jupiter: Many journeys, trouble through relatives and the Church or law, help from friends.
aspects.mars: Cruelty, violence, scandal and slan- der, disgrace and ruin, danger of dog bites.
aspects.mercury: Occult interest, minor position of management under Government, trouble and scandal through opposite sex, favourable for health and gain.
aspects.neptune: Sensitive and mediumistic, notor- ious through and luck in speculation, political 193 interests, wealthy friends, favourable for domestic matters, death from tumorous growth after unsuc- cessful operation leaving financial affairs involved.
aspects.saturn: Good judgment, high position of trust often in connection with land, may be adopted by aged couple from whom a good inheritance is obtained, benefits from elderly friends, good health, domestic harmony, marriage to one of higher station.
aspects.uranus: Broad-minded, liberal, minister or speaker on religious and philosophical subjects, not limited to any definite creed, many friends among the people, favourable for domestic matters.
aspects.venus: Many benefits from influential friends, associated with the Church, favourable for gain.

stars.name: Manubrium
stars.influence: Of the nature of the Sun and liars. It causes blindness, explosions, fire, flaring heat, heroism, courage, and defiance.
stars.notes: Part of the cluster in the Archer’s Face.

stars.name: Markab
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the na- ture of Mars and Mercury ; to Simmonite, of Mars and Venus ; and, to Alvidas, of Jupiter in square to Mercury with Saturn from Pisces and Gemini. It gives honour, riches, fortune, danger from fevers, cuts, blows, stabs and fire and a violent death.
stars.notes: A white star situated on the wing of Pegasus. From Markab, a Saddle, Ship or Vehicle, or, according to Ballinger, Returning from Afar.
stars.with_sun: Energetic, unlucky, impermanent martial honours, disappointed ambitions, accidents, sickness.
stars.with_moon: Injuries from enemies, bad for gain and domestic matters, fairly good health but many accidents. If Mars be with Moon, death by wild beasts or soldiers. If a malefic be with Cingula Orionis, death by human hands.
stars.culminating: Disgrace, ruin and often a vio- lent death.

aspects.jupiter: Trouble and loss through legal matters, danger of judicial sentence or banishment and exile.
aspects.mars: Quarrelsome, violent, many diffi- culties and losses through Mercurial affairs.
aspects.mercury: Good mind, rash and headstrong, quick in speech, diplomatic, capable writer, criticized, friends become enemies, bad for gain. Wifi Venus. Evil associates, «lrink and other excesses, bad for gain.
aspects.neptune: Unbalanced or abnormal mind, many disappointments, emotional, romantic, dis- tasteful environment, secret enemies, domestic disharmony, many accidents, violent death in early life. With a malefic and the Moon at the same time with Cingula Orionis, death by drowning.
aspects.saturn: Bom in poverty, prison or asylum, may be abandoned, hard life, imprisoned for crime, .few friends, unfavourable for domestic matters, death under similar conditions to birth.
aspects.uranus: Evil habits, mental disturbances, dever, wanderer, unavailing efforts, peculiar life, trouble with parent of opposite sex, bad for gain and domestic matters, many accidents, violent death.

stars.name: Menkar
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Saturn ; to Simmonite, of Mars ; and, to Alvidas, of Venus and the Moon. It causes disease, disgrace, ruin, injury from beasts, sickness, and loss of fortune.
stars.notes: A bright orange star situated in the jaw of the Whale. From A 1 Minhar, the Nose.
stars.with_sun: Great 'trouble, sickness, throat ail- ments, legacies and inheritances attended by much evil, loss of money, failure of crops.
stars.with_moon: Mental anxiety, hatred of the vulgar, ill-will of women, danger from thieves, sickness to native and family, loss of marriage partner or near relative, quarrels, legal losses, legacies and inheritances attended by much evil.
stars.culminating: Disgrace, ruin, danger from cattle and large beasts.

aspects.jupiter: Deceitful, dishonest, wandering life, imprisonment, banishment, or judicial sentence. With Sal urn. Self-seeking, selfish, causes un- happiness to others, much sickness, bad for gain.
aspects.mars: Evil associates, immoral, violent, murderous, violent death.
aspects.mercury: Difficulties through writings, difficulty in payment of mortgages, bad for gain, ill-health to marriage partner or relative, destruction of crops. '
aspects.uranus: Active mind, artistic, scientific and mystical interest and ability, troubles through opposite sex, loss through fire and false friends, good fortune and misfortune alternately, severe injuries from animals. I Vith Neptune. Peculiar early life, loss of or separa- tion from parents abroad, may lose identity and be brought up by foreigners in dishonour, learns of parentage too late in life to obtain advantage, brave, organizing ability, high position, wasted talents, many journeys, violent death frequently by assas- sination.
aspects.venus: Strong and uncontrolled passions, jealousy, domestic disharmony and temporary separation, ill-health of marriage partner.

stars.name: Menkazinan
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mars and Mercury. 'It causes ruin, disgrace, and frequently violent death.

stars.name: Min taka
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Satum and Mercury ; and, to Alvidas, of Mercury, Satum and Jupiter. It gives good fortune.
stars.notes: A slightly variable double star, brilliant white and pale violet situated in Orion's belt. From A1 Mintakih, the Belt, or Dividing.
stars.with_sun: Discreet, cautious, somewhat change- able.
stars.with_moon: Active, sharp, alert in business, public position, many enemies, more successful in business. Wffc Mercury. Studious, fond of seclusion, deliberate and fixed mind, little sympathy or dis- agreements with relatives, bad for gain.

aspects.jupiter: High position in law or Church, studious and philosophical mind, gain through inheritance.
aspects.mars: Energetic, quick mind, good speaker and debater, quarrelsome, strong passions.
aspects.neptune: Thoughtful, studious, keeps discoveries to himself, sarcastic writer, generous but not wealthy, rarely marries, death unattended in old age. {See Cingula Orionis).
aspects.saturn: Far-seeing, studious, good fudge of human nature, psychic, domestic disharmony, sickncss>to family.
aspects.uranus: Selfish, studious, eccentric, diffi- cult to get on with, losses through lawsuits and business, successful in middle age but poverty at end of life, favourable for domestic matters, death from consumption.
aspects.venus: Public position, enmity of women, love disappointments, u

stars.name: Mirach
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of th® nature of Venus ; and, to Alvidas, of Mars and the Moon. It gives personal beauty, a brilliant mind, a love of home, great devotion, beneficence, for- giveness love, overcoming by kindness, renown, and good fortune in marriage.
stars.notes: A yellow star situated in the girdle of Andromeda. From Mirak, the Loins. Often called Zona Andromed*, or Andromeda's Girdle.
stars.with_sun: Trouble through opposite sex, disappointments in expectations but otherwise favourable.
stars.with_moon: Trouble with opposite sex owing 179 to indiscretions, bad for domestic affairs, honour through martial matters.

aspects.jupiter: Help from women but danger of scandal, much travel, legal or ecclesiastical diffi- culties.
aspects.mars: Ill-mannered, boisterous, evil associations, may be tramp.
aspects.mercury: Vacillating, unstable, peculiar events, many travels and changes, little success.
aspects.neptune: Persevering, ambitious, strong passions, eccentric, dishonest, domestic disharmony and separation, may disinherit children or family, trouble through companies and inventions, success- ful business, many enemies and few friends, painful and lingering death.
aspects.saturn: Strong passions, debauchery, mechanical genius, misdirected talents.
aspects.uranus: Unbalanced mind, may commit crime m insanity, occult interests, continual dis- appointments, bad for domestic affairs, peculiar or violent death.
aspects.venus: Voluptuous, bad morals, scandal, drink or drug-taking late in life.

stars.name: Nashira
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Saturn and Jupiter ; and, to Simmonite, « of Saturn. It causes overcoming by evil, which is turned to success, and gives danger from beasts. i8o
stars.notes: Situated in the tail of the Goat. From A 1 Sa’d al Nashvrah, the Fortunate One or Bringer of Good Tidings ; or, according to Bullinger, the Record of the Cutting Off.

stars.name: Oculus
stars.influence: Of the nature of Saturn and Venus. It gives a clever and piercing intellect when in conjunction with Mercury.
stars.notes: A small star in the right eye of the Goat.

stars.name: POUS
stars.influence: Of the nature of Jupiter and Mars. It gives success, high ambition, martial desires, horsemanship, keen perception and domination.
stars.notes: A triple star in the upper part of the bow of Sagittarius. From the Coptic Polts, a Foal.

stars.name: Pelagus
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Jupiter and Mercury ; and, to Alvidas, of Saturn and Mercury. It gives truthfulness, optim- ism and a religious mind.
stars.notes: A small star situated on the vane of the arrow at the Archer’s hand.
stars.with_sun: Influential public position, favourable for domestic and family matters.
stars.with_moon: Successful writer on science, philo- sophy, education or agriculture, unorthodox in religion, defeats enemies, many friends, illness of a Saturnian nature.

aspects.jupiter: Diplomatic, philosophical mind, writer, ecclesiastical or legal preferment.
aspects.mars: Reserved, diplomatic, strong mind, courageous, energetic, straightforward, false friends, favourable for gain.
aspects.mercury: High government position, popu- lar criticism, wealth, anxiety on account of illness to wife or mother.
aspects.neptune: Practical, occult interests, wealthy, associated with large concerns, some domestic disagreements, defeats enemies, natural death in old age.
aspects.saturn: Thoughtful, reserved, self-centred, success delayed until after 50, ambition thwarted by enemies, danger of disgrace, wealth at end of life. trouble to parents, favourable marriage late in life, usually at least one child. JTO Uranus. Proud, industrious, aggressive, high government or business position, early disgrace, especially if female, favourable for marriage in x middle age, sudden gains and losses, many friends, natural death.
aspects.venus: Heart rules head, favours from opposite sex, many friends.

stars.name: Phact
stars.influence: Of the nature of Venus and Mercury. It gives beneficence, hopefulness and good fortune.
stars.notes: Situated at the base of the right wing of the Dove. Said to be from Had’ar, Ground, or Fached, the Thigh.

stars.name: Pleiades
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy they are of the nature of the Moon and Mars ; and, to Alvidas, of Mars, Moon and Sun in opposition. They are said to make their natives wanton, ambitious, turbulent, op t i mi stic and peaceful ; to give many journeys and voyages, success in agriculture and through active intelligence; and to cause blindness, disgrace and a violent death. Their influence is distinctly evil and there is no astrological warrant for the oft-quoted passage in Job (xxxviii. 31), "Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades . . - ? which is probably a mistranslation.
stars.notes: The Pleiades form a duster, with Alcyone as the principal star, situated on the shoulder of the Bull. For all practical purposes the longitude of Alcyone may be used for the whole group, as all are contained within about one degree of longi- _ tude.
stars.with_sun: Throat ailments, chronic catarrh, blindness, bad eyes, injuries to the face, sickness, disgrace, evil disposition, murderer or murdered, imprisonment, death by pestilence, blows, stabs, shooting, beheading or shipwreck. If in 7th house, blindness, especially if Saturn or Mars be with Regulus. If with Mars and Venus the native will be a potent king obeyed by many people but subject to many infirmities.
stars.with_moon: Injuries to the face, sickness, mis- fortune, wounds, stabs, disgrace, imprisonment, blindness, defective sight especially if in the Ascend- ant or one of the other angles, may be cross-eyed, colour-blind or the eyes may be affected by some growth. If in the 7th house, total blindness es- pecially if Saturn or Mars be with Regulus and the Moon be combust.
stars.culminating: Blindness, ophthalmia, injuries to the eyes and face, disgrace, wounds, stabs, exile, im- prisonment, sickness, violent fevers, quarrels, violent lust, militar y preferment. If at the same time the iE 183 Sun is in opposition either to the Ascendant or -to Mars, violent death. jf culminating.' Disgrace, ruin, violent death. If with the luminaries it makes its natives military cap- tains, commanders, colonels of horse and emperors.

aspects.jupiter: Deceit, hypocrisy, legal and ec- clesiastical troubles, loss through relatives, banish- ment or imprisonment.
aspects.mars: Many accidents to the head, loss and suffering through fires. If at the same time Saturn is with Regulus, violent death in a tumult.
aspects.mercury: Many disappointments, loss of possessions, much loss from legal affairs, business failure, trouble through children.
aspects.neptune: Bold, military preferment, hon- our, wealth, help from friends, many serious acci- dents, many travels, somewhat dishonourable oc- cupation involving secrecy, ill-health to marriage partner and peculiar conditions respecting parentage, bad for children, may lose everything at end of life, violent death, often abroad while following occupa- tion.
aspects.saturn: Cautious, much sickness, tumor- ous ailments, chronic sickness to family, many Josses.
aspects.uranus: Active mind, deformity from birth or through accident in childhood, many accidents and troubles, many unexpected losses often through fire or enemies, marriage partner proves false es- pecially if female, troubles through women, occult interests, unfavourable for children, if any, and lack of harmony with them, heavy losses at end of life, violent death.
aspects.venus: Immoral, strong passions, disgrace through women, sickness, loss of fortune.

stars.name: Polaris
stars.influence: Of tlic nature of Saturn and Venus. It causes much sickness, trouble, loss of fortune, dis- grace and great affliction, and may give legacies and inheritances attended by much evil. The Arabs were of the opinion that the contemplation of Polaris cured ophthalmia. li’i/Ji Sun. Many troubles and evils. U’i/Ji Moon. Hatred of the vulgar, ill-will of women and danger from thieves.

stars.name: Potxux
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the na- . ture of Mars ; and, to A 1 vidas, of the Moon, Mars and Uranus. It gives a subtle, crafty, spirited, brave, audacious, cruel and rash nature, a love of boxing, dignified malevolence, and is connected with poisons. 1J rising. Bad eyes, blindness, injuries to the face, sickness, wounds, imprisonment, ephemeral honour and preferment.
stars.with_sun: Occult and philosophical interests, blows, stabs, serious accidents, shooting, shipwreck, murderer or murdered, extreme sickness and di- seases, fevers, ailments affecting the stomach, evil disposition, riches and honour but final ruin, blind- ness, injuries to the head and face, quarrels, rape committed or suffered, banishment, imprisonment for embezzling, violent death, decapitation.
stars.with_moon: Hatred of the vulgar, ill-will of women, danger from thieves, violent death, power, pride, sickness, calamity, wounds, imprisonment, injuries to face, defective sight or blindness especi- ally if Mars or the Sun be in square from Aries. If Mars or the Sim be in square from Libra, danger of accidents and legal or matrimonial troubles ; but, if in opposition from Capricorn, danger to the mother’s honour and reputation. If Mars be in conjunction, death by suffocation, drowning of assassination. If Mars be with Arcturus in the ist, 7th, 9th, 10th or nth houses, death by suffocation.
stars.culminating: Honour and preferment but danger of disgrace and ruin.

aspects.mercury: Unbalanced mind, unpopular and peculiar occupation, trouble with father through relatives or enemies, domestic disharmony, anxiety, loss through land, property and mines.
aspects.neptune: Changeable, many travels, excel- lent linguist, many influential friends, good for partnership, peculiar conditions in marriage and partner often a foreigner, occupation connected with exploration or zoological and botanical work abroad, minor accidents, isolated death through fever or virulent disease.
aspects.saturn: Bad temper, bitter, sarcastic, loss of arm or leg, loss of parents or trouble through step- parents, much help from a friend, lack of education, sudden death while following occupation through horses or large animals.
aspects.uranus: Occult interests, psychic ability, selfish, proud, vain of personal appearance, success in connection with the Government, companies or electrical matters, harmonious marriage in middle age, favourable for children, end of life not so favour- able as middle.
aspects.venus: Strong and irregulatcd passions, danger of seduction if female, loss through women, danger of poison. IVifh Mars. Violent, murderer or murdered, high position but final ruin, violent death by suffocation, drowning or assassination especially if the Moon be there also. Il'itt Jupiter. Legal losses, high position but danger of disgrace, trouble through relatives, banish- ment or imprisonment.

stars.name: Presspe
stars.influence: It is of the nature of Mars and the Moon, and causes disease, disgrace, adventure, insolence, wantonness, brutality, blindness, industry, order and fecundity ; and makes its natives fortun- ate though liable to loss through others, and the founders of large businesses.
stars.notes: A coarse extended cluster situated on the head of the Crab. Popularly termed the Beehive, Manger or Crib, and known by the Chinese tinder the name Tseih She Ke, Exhalation of Piled-up Corpses. With the Aselli it was the *' cloudy spot , of Cancer " mentioned by Ptolemy as causing blind- ness.
stars.with_sun: Evil disposition, murderer or murdered, blows, stabs, serious accidents, shooting, shipwreck, execution, banishment, imprisonment, sharp diseases, fevers, luemorrhage, lawsuits, danger of death from fire, iron or stones, injuries to the face, wounds, bad eyes, and if in an angle blindness.
stars.with_moon: Wounds, stabs, imprisonment, in- juries to the face, sickness, blindness or eye injuries especially if Saturn or Mars be with Regulus.
stars.culminating: Disgrace, ruin and violent death.

stars.name: Princeps
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mercury and Saturn. ( It gives a keen, studious and profound mind, with j the ability for research.
stars.notes: ^ A pale yellow star situated in the spear- shaft of Bofltes.
stars.culminating: Good fortune, but troubles, discontent and fear occasioned by own temerity rather than circumstances.

stars.name: Procyon
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy it is of the nature of Mercury and Mars ; to Simmonite, of Venus and Mazs, which is probably a misprint ; and, to Alvidas, of the Moon, Jupiter and Uranus. It gives activity, violence, sudden and violent malevolence, sudden preferment by exertion, ele- , vation ending in disaster, danger of dog bites and hydrophobia, and makes its natives petulant, saucy, ‘ giddy, weak-natured, timid, unfortunate, proud, easily angered, careless and violent. Two cases are 1 on record of death or injury by dog bite in which ' Procyon and Sirius are involved.
stars.notes: A binary yellowish white and yellow Star situated on the body of the Lesser Dog. From Prokuon, before the Dog, in allusion to its rising before Sirius.

stars.name: Propus
stars.influence: Of the nature of Mercury and Venus. It gives strength, eminence and success. v/84. Rasalhague. a ophiuchi. t 21° 20'.
stars.notes: A sapphire star situated on the head of Ophiuchus. From Ras al Hawwa, the Head of the Serpent Charmer.
stars.with_sun: Reserved, thoughtful, studious, sus- picious, solitary, reputation for athletics, little wealth, careless of public opinion.
stars.with_moon: Public prominence in religious matters, favourable for gain.

aspects.jupiter: Diplomatic, religious or legal pre- ferment, but some criticism, favourable for gain.
aspects.mercury: Unpopular attitude and criticism through religion, philosophy or science ; difficulties in marriage and quarrels fostered by others, trouble through opposite sex, not very good for gain. With Ven us. Quick mind, well educated, cautious, secretive, suspicious, unfavourable for gain. HTfft Mars. Trouble through writings, public censure in connection with religion, science ot philosophy, bad for gain. jj
aspects.neptune: Hypocritical, self-seeking, able speaker or writer, but panders to the public, occult, religious or scientific work, but largely misleading, minor Government position, domestic disharmony, ill-health to marriage partner, disappointment over legacy, peculiar death sometimes through fall but animal and human agency may be suspected.
aspects.saturn: Selfish, unpopular, determined, fixed opinions, successful, somewhat dishonest, domestic disharmony through jealousy, marriage partner may be invalid, losses of a Mercurial nature.
aspects.uranus: Strong passions, strong nature but changeable, ambitious, occult interests, seeks popularity, easily swayed though outwardly aggres- sive, reverence for ancestry, benefits through elderly and influential people and public affairs, unfavourable for marriage and children, if any. trouble through opposite sex, sudden death.

stars.name: Prtoa Hyadum
stars.influence: According to Ptolemy they are of the nature of Satum and Mercury ; and, to Alvidas, of Mercury and Mars. Simmonite likens them to Mars but this is probably a misinterpretation of Ptolemy’s meaning. Very little is known as to the effect of the fixed stars in mundane astrology although there is no doubt that their influence is of supreme importance in this branch of the subject.
